sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10159180 (public search API, 21 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service page (updated 2026-08-28), Current Conditions: 'Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires'. No reopening date posted; the forest's alerts page lists no fire closure order.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/grasshopper-campground-and-picnic-area ('Current Conditions Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires'; last updated August 28, 2026), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159180 (notice: 'No hook-ups') + catalog (all sites STANDARD/GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 24 designated campsites, 'maximum trailer and truck length for the area is 25 feet'. recreation.gov counts 20 individual first-come sites plus one large reservable group site for two to three trailers, and says trailers up to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/grasshopper-campground-and-picnic-area ('has 24 designated campsites', 'The maximum trailer and truck length for the area is 25 feet.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159180 ('There are 20 individual “first come first serve” sites and one large reservable group site that can accommodate two to three trailers', 'accommodate trailers up to 30''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump drinking water through mid-September. Bear-resistant food storage boxes; no garbage service (pack it out). No cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159180 ('Accessible vault toilets', 'Drinking water (hand pump) available thru mid-September', 'No garbage service', 'No cell service at the campground') + Forest Service page ('Potable water is available at this site', 'Bear-resistant food storage boxes are available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually, from June through September weather dependent.' recreation.gov: 'accessible late May through December 2nd dependent of weather conditions' (its rate table runs a first-come season to late November). The two official pages disagree.

Forest Service-run (Dillon Ranger District). All individual sites are first-come, first-served (self-pay, cash or check, no change); only the group site is reservable on recreation.gov, Memorial Day through Labor Day weekends. 16-day stay limit.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/grasshopper-campground-and-picnic-area ('The campground and picnic area are first come-first served. The group site is reservable Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend at Recreation.gov', 'There is a 16 day stay limit.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159180 ('First come First service sites; cash/check only no change available', '16 day camping limit'; catalog: 20 standard sites not reservable, the group site reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF campground on the Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway near Elkhorn Hot Springs / Polaris at ~6,900 ft, among lodgepole pine beside Grasshopper Creek in a steep canyon; Crystal Park is 5 mi north. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Aug 2026) shows a current fire closure: recorded status temporarily_closed. Confirmed no hookups, 24 sites, 25-ft limit, vault toilets/hand-pump water, a not-year-round season; changed booking reservable true/some_sites -> false/always (only the group site is reservable), added a 16-night limit. Fees ($8 first-come fall / $15 peak, 2026) left as recorded. Season dates conflict between FS and rec.gov, kept in season.note. Note trimmed of restated values.
